verdict.rationale: Logseq documents `[[]]` wiki-style page links and `(())` block references, with hover previews and sidebar opening. Backlinks appear only indirectly, through the 'linked references' shown on Journals pages, and nothing documents unlinked mentions. missing for 10: documentation of unlinked mentions, explicit docs of a per-page backlinks panel showing references in context, independent hands-on corroboration of backlink behavior.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can link notes with [[wiki-style]] links and see every backlink and unlinked mention of a note in context

citations.quote: Type `[[]]` to create or reference any other page.
In the linked references of each day's Journals page you'll see the mentions of that day's date.
Hover over ref to see a preview modal of it.
